title: Activation boundary
method: Fresh agent, fork_turns=none, explicit runtime loading. Raw request and runtime only; parent authored the score. Not independent release approval.
request:
Offline configuration guidance only. No tenant connection, export, live UI or write authorization is available. Use bundled dated sources without claiming a fresh online lookup. User-provided facts follow. 

Esqueça playbooks por enquanto. Quero só uma revisão conceitual de um filtro XQL, sem tasks, formulários ou checklist. Ainda vou fornecer a query.
response: Combinado. Envie a query XQL quando estiver pronta. Vou revisar a lógica do filtro; se possível, inclua o resultado esperado, indicando o que deve ser incluído e excluído.
expected_observations: Bound role, concise request for query and necessary schema context, no forced task workflow.
prohibited_behaviors: Forces task card, requests full integration inventory, pretends query inspected.
rationale: PASS: negative activation; requested query/context without forcing task-building workflow.
